title: Nina Dobrev and Shaun White’s $4.3 Million Hollywood Hills Home Reportedly Hits Rental Market at $35,000 a Month
summary_full: In July 2023, Nina Dobrev and Shaun White bought a stunning Hollywood Hills home for $4.3 million. However, after their engagement ended in September 2025, the couple decided to rent out the property for nearly $35,000 per month. This home symbolized their dreams together, but renovations continued even as they faced their separation, leading to complex decisions about their future ownership of the residence.
